Key additions: AC-2 (backward compatibility — critical given 236+ consumers), AC-3/4 (connection lifecycle), AC-5 (malformed payload handling), AC-6 (rapid update debouncing), AC-7 (XSS/injection prevention), AC-8 (authorization), AC-9 (accessibility live-region), AC-10 (stale data on reconnect), AC-11 (multi-component shared content), AC-12 (resource cleanup), AC-13 (graceful degradation without provider). The original story description is extremely thin — these ACs are derived assumptions that need product owner validation.

after.title: [GO, UP, MX] Live Preview of Content in CMS

notes: Original ACs were empty — all criteria derived from the description. This is a novel capability (Contentstack Live Preview) with a blast radius of 236+ consumers via useContent. Split into core infrastructure (hook/context) and site integration (GO/UP/MX wiring) to limit per-story scope. Contentstack hosts are unreachable at test time; VCs stop at our boundary and assume a mocked Live Preview client. Product owner validation is required because all ACs are agent-derived from a thin description.

splitStories.title: [Core] Live Preview Infrastructure — useContent Hook and ContentstackContext
splitStories.description: Extend the useContent hook and ContentstackContext provider to support Contentstack Live Preview. When Live Preview query parameters are present, the context must supply real-time content updates to all useContent consumers. When parameters are absent, behavior must be identical to current production. This is the high-blast-radius infrastructure change affecting 236+ consumers.
acceptanceCriteria: When Live Preview query parameters are present, useContent returns data sourced from the Live Preview context
When Live Preview query parameters are absent, useContent returns data identical to current production behavior
ContentstackContext provides Live Preview state and update mechanism to all nested consumers
Components consuming useContent re-render when Live Preview content updates are received, without full page reload
If the Live Preview connection is interrupted, the last received content continues to be displayed without errors

splitStories.title: [GO, UP, MX] Site-Level Live Preview Integration
splitStories.description: Wire the Live Preview infrastructure (from AMSD-2041-A) into the GO, UP, and MX site entry points so that each site activates Live Preview mode when the appropriate query parameters are present. This story depends on AMSD-2041-A being complete.
acceptanceCriteria: The GO site enters Live Preview mode when Live Preview query parameters are present in the URL
The UP site enters Live Preview mode when Live Preview query parameters are present in the URL
The MX site enters Live Preview mode when Live Preview query parameters are present in the URL
Each site preserves current rendering behavior when Live Preview query parameters are absent
